evidence_slice: City of York Council adopted the City of York Local Plan on 27 February 2025. Adopted Policy SS9 identifies Land East of Metcalfe Lane (site ST7) as a strategic allocation to deliver approximately 845 dwellings. City of York Council's public 2025 adopted Local Plan Policies Map exposes the Spatial Strategy (areas) layer as polygon geometry in British National Grid EPSG:27700, and the layer legend includes Land East of Metcalfe Lane.
binding_method: authority-hosted adopted polygon policy layer plus exact strategic-site and policy references; exact feature extraction and canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: Official council HTML/PDF evidence and GIS metadata were accessed through public web transport; exact raw feature/PDF bytes were not acquired, so no source-file hash is fabricated.
